The literal 'SEG' pipeline artifact appears twice at @15 and @20, each followed by an option letter (ج، د). Decimals and superscripts are stripped: '2 4 مليون كم 2' is 2.4 million km².
law: §S. 20 lines × [stem ‖ opt ‖ opt ‖ opt ‖ opt] = 100 boundaries over 439 tokens (4.4 tokens/segment). Run the three tests in order — modal option count (four, uniformly here), head-recurrence (S4), uniform option shape (S5) — and never reason from content.
